function.name: OUT_REGION
function.abstract: It returns 1 if a process is out of the region indicated

description.p: This function allows to check if a process has been drawn in or out of a region on screen. The region can be independent of any scroll region or trims defined for the process. In any case, the function returns 1 if the process is found completely out of the limits of the region, an 0 if any part or all process is in of the limits of the region.

Before calling to this function, it is necessary to have established the limits of the region by , if it is not used the region 0, that corresponds always to all screen and offers a form simple if a process is out of screen.
If you want to check if the current process is out of a region, use the instruction to obtain his identifier.
